lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，我要品尝你的肉！
lines.en: Sssss, time to taste your flesh!
Run, or I’ll get you!
Prey is nearby, hunt it!

lines.zh: 追踪你的气味，你逃不掉！
lines.en: Following your scent, you can’t escape!

lines.zh: 躲起来吧，但我总能找到你！
lines.en: Hide, but I’ll find you!

lines.zh: 吸食你的生命，直到你枯萎！
lines.en: Suck your life until you wither!
My mouth will be your grave!

lines.zh: 腐化的猎物，我不会放过的！
lines.en: Corrupted prey, I won’t let go!

lines.zh: 灰烬下移动，獠牙已张开。
lines.en: Moving beneath the ash, jaws already open.

lines.zh: 沿洼地滑行，追着你的脚步。
lines.en: I slide along the hollow, following your steps.

lines.zh: 沙沙作响，我正从土里爬出。
lines.en: Rustling—I am crawling out of the soil.
The wind-worn hollow is my hunting ground.
Silently, waiting for your scent.
Corrupted scent, makes me excited.

lines.zh: 在这里猎杀你，再合适不过。
lines.en: Here’s where I hunt you, perfectly.
Warmth of the bones, so enticing.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋得只剩一道缝。
lines.en: I bury myself until only a seam shows.
Corrupted secrets, hidden underground.

lines.zh: 等待你的脚步声，如此诱人。
lines.en: Footsteps, so enticing to wait for.

lines.zh: 腐化的猎物，我不会放过。
lines.en: Corrupted prey, I won’t let go.
Patience, the power of corruption.
Corrupted smell, everywhere.

lines.zh: 埋在灰里，只露出一排牙。
lines.en: Buried in ash, only a row of teeth showing.
I count the footprints in the ash.
The ash is cold, but my fangs are hot.
I lie still as an old bone.

lines.zh: 灰烬里张开的嘴，别踩进来。
lines.en: The mouth in the ash: do not step in.
Player found me, I’ll act now.
Crouch! Otherwise, you’re done!
Don’t move, come closer!
You can’t escape, I’m coming.
Crouch, or it’s dangerous.
You moved too fast, be careful!
Player noticed, run!
Crouch, or you’ll get hurt!
Come closer, I don’t mind.

lines.zh: 蹲下，不然我的牙就咬上了。
lines.en: Crouch, or my teeth will close on you.
Do you see the ash heap moving?

lines.zh: 别踩那片灰，那是我的嘴。
lines.en: Don't step on that ash—it is my mouth.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我就咬一口。
lines.en: One more step and I bite.
I will lunge when I reach three.

lines.zh: 蹲下，我讨厌够不着的猎物。
lines.en: Crouch—I hate prey I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在我的灰堆上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my ash heap.
The wind brings your scent to me.
I am here, right beneath your feet.
Looking up won't help—I am in the dirt.
You triggered Death's Maw's trap.
Death's Maw watches in the dark.
Don't let me catch you.
My jaw is pried half open.
Death's Maw won't let you go easily.
My shell is cracked. I can't hide.
Just one bite is enough.
You can't escape me.
You've angered Death's Maw.
Death's Maw will not fail.

lines.zh: 腐肉诱惑着你靠近，愚蠢的旅人。
lines.en: 腐meat tempts you close, foolish traveler.

lines.zh: 别靠近，旅人，腐肉在召唤。
lines.en: Don't come closer, traveler, the flesh calls to you.

lines.zh: 闻闻这腐肉的气味吧，它将吞噬你。
lines.en: Smell the stench of this flesh, it will consume you.

lines.zh: 你无法抗拒这腐肉的诱惑。
lines.en: You cannot resist the temptation of this flesh.

lines.zh: 你已经闻到了吗？腐肉的味道。
lines.en: You can smell it, can't you? The stench of flesh.
The scent of flesh draws you in.
You are drawn by the smell of flesh.

lines.zh: 别理会那腐肉，它会害你。
lines.en: Ignore the flesh, it will harm you.
Death lurks in the flesh.
Flesh is your downfall.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩塌了我的坑。
lines.en: Your boot caves in my pit.
My teeth graze your ankle.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩到了不该踩的地方。
lines.en: Your foot has stepped where it shouldn't.
You've angered Death's Maw.

lines.zh: 你触碰了不该触碰的生物。
lines.en: You've touched an untouchable creature.

lines.zh: 你触碰了不该触碰的危险。
lines.en: You've touched a dangerous thing.

lines.zh: 你触碰了不该触碰的区域。
lines.en: You've touched a forbidden area.

lines.zh: 你触碰了不该触碰的陷阱。
lines.en: You've triggered a trap.

lines.zh: 你触碰了不该触碰的秘密。
lines.en: You've touched a secret you shouldn't.

lines.zh: 你踩上来了，别怪我不客气。
lines.en: You stepped on me—don't blame me.

lines.zh: 找到配偶是我们的使命。
lines.en: Finding a mate is our purpose.
We need a companion.
In the ash, you stepped on me first.

lines.zh: 我们的力量在繁衍中增强。
lines.en: Our strength grows in reproduction.

lines.zh: 灰烬里露出我的嘴，别踩。
lines.en: My mouth shows through the ash — mind your step.
Our future is in each other.
Find your partner.
Our lineage needs you.

lines.zh: 寻找你的同类，繁衍生命。
lines.en: Find your kind, to continue life.
Reproduction is our duty.
腐骨，my new prey.
Putrid skin, your doom.
You can't escape, rotten flesh.
腐骨, your final resting place.
Corrupted life, join me.
腐骨, my feast.
Corrupted souls, mine to claim.
Corrupted bones, my prey.
Putrid skin, I'll consume.
Corrupted life, I harvest.

lines.zh: 你踩到灰里的我了，蹲下才能松口。
lines.en: You stepped on me in the ash; crouch if you want loose.
Corrupted aura, my call.

lines.zh: 腐化的气息，吸引我的猎物。
lines.en: Corruption, drawing my prey.

lines.zh: 腐化的灵魂，即将被收割。
lines.en: Corrupted souls, to be reaped.

lines.zh: 腐化的生命，落入我的陷阱。
lines.en: Corrupted life, into my snare.

lines.zh: 腐化的猎物，即将落入我的手中。
lines.en: Corrupted prey, soon mine.

lines.zh: 腐化的气息，我的猎物到来了。
lines.en: Corruption, my prey approaches.

lines.zh: 腐化的生命，落入我的掌控。
lines.en: Corrupted life, under my control.
Corrupted prey, before me.

lines.zh: 腐化的气息，我的猎物已现。
lines.en: Corruption, my prey revealed.

lines.zh: 你踏入洼地，我认得你的重量。
lines.en: You entered the hollow; I know your weight.
Found them—the ankles under the ash.
Your scent is caught; running won't help.
One prey—just enough for a meal.
I hear your knees shaking.
The target is just above my ash pile.
Corrupted prey, my meal.
Corrupted souls, I harvest.
Corrupted flesh, my delicacy.
Corrupted prey, my feast.
Corrupted life, my quarry.
Corrupted prey, my target.
Corrupted aura, my prey.
Corrupted prey, my bounty.
Corrupted prey, my pursuit.
Open wide; wait for them to come closer.

lines.zh: 咬住就不松口，除非你蹲下。
lines.en: Once I bite, I hold—unless you crouch.

lines.zh: 腐烂从我的牙缝里渗出来。
lines.en: Rot seeps from between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我要咬的是你踩灰的那只脚。
lines.en: The foot that stepped in the ash is the one I bite.
They hesitate; wait one more breath.

lines.zh: 灰会盖住你倒下时的声音。
lines.en: The ash will muffle your fall.

lines.zh: 我的牙已经对准了他的腿。
lines.en: My teeth are lined up with their leg.
Half a step closer and you are mine.

lines.zh: 咬合的一瞬，腐肉就开始了。
lines.en: The moment I bite, the rot begins.
They want to crouch—too late.

lines.zh: 舌头尝到了土里的汗味。
lines.en: My tongue tastes sweat in the soil.

lines.zh: 你感到一股寒意贯穿全身。
lines.en: Chill runs through your body.

lines.zh: 腐骨从你的伤口中掉落。
lines.en: Corrupted bones fall from your wounds.
You are enveloped in rot.

lines.zh: 它的牙齿在你皮肤上留下痕迹。
lines.en: Its teeth mark your skin.

lines.zh: 腐骨的气味弥漫在空气中。
lines.en: The smell of corrupted bones fills the air.
Corrupted blood drips onto the ground.
Its breath is suffocating.
Corrupted bones decay in your hands.
Your skin starts to rot.
Corrupted bones meld with your flesh.

lines.zh: 牙合上了，腐烂钻进骨头。
lines.en: My jaws close; rot seeps into the bone.

lines.zh: 咬住你的小腿，别想甩开。
lines.en: I have your calf—no shaking me off.
Ash and blood spray out.

lines.zh: 我的牙缝里塞满了你的皮。
lines.en: Your skin is stuck between my teeth.
One bite and the rot spreads.

lines.zh: 你蹲得够快，才保得住这条腿。
lines.en: Crouch fast and you keep that leg.

lines.zh: 风蚀洼地中飘来腐臭气息。
lines.en: A foul stench wafts from the eroded hollow.
Void ash swirls in the air.
Its fangs emerge from the ashes.
Corrupted bones sway in the wind.
Corrupted bones gleam in the ashes.
You see its corrupted corpse.
Its corrupted bones drift on the wind.

lines.zh: 腐骨在风中发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Corrupted bones hiss in the wind.
Corrupted bones sway in the wind.
Corrupted bones decay in the wind.
The ash heap in the hollow swells.
A pair of fangs surfaces from the dirt.
The wind stopped—time for me to come out.

lines.zh: 骨荒原的灰下有什么在动。
lines.en: Something stirs beneath the Bone Wastes' ash.

lines.zh: 我从风蚀的沟里翻身而起。
lines.en: I roll up out of the wind-worn groove.
The soil cracks and shows my mouth.
Don't think this ash pile is dead.
I opened my eyes at the bottom of the hollow.
Ash settles; the teeth show.
This hollow has a master again.

lines.zh: 灰底下的肉被烤得发紧。
lines.en: The flesh under the ash tightens in the heat.
I fell because of you.
You drowned me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从灰里掀出来。
lines.en: The blast throws me out of the ash.
The arrow buries itself in my hollow.
I was hit by magic.
There's nothing chewable in the ash.
I was struck by lightning.
Void power hurt me.
